name: Chao hau
summary: Cháo hàu is rice porridge with oysters, finished with fried shallots, cilantro, and fish sauce. It is the soft bowl to order after a day out.
origin: Vung Tau, where it is the soft bowl after a day out.
howToEat: Eat it from the bowl, with the fried shallots and cilantro, when you want something soft after a day out.
seoTitle: Chao hau in Vung Tau — oyster rice porridge
seoDescription: Cháo hàu in Vung Tau is rice porridge with oysters, fried shallots, cilantro, and fish sauce, the soft bowl after a day out.
